newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING says Equitable of Iowa a perfect fit.
newsitem.headline: ING says Equitable of Iowa a perfect fit.

text.p: Dutch financial services group ING Groep NV (ING) said on Tuesday Equitable of Iowa Companies was a perfect fit with its U.S. life operations.
ING earlier announced it had reached agreement to buy Equitable of Iowa for $68 per share with a mix of ING shares and cash, in a deal valuing the target at $2.2 billion.

ING spokesman Ruud Polet told Reuters ING's North American life insurance operations were active in the higher and lower income segments of the life insurance market while the U.S. company was strong in the middle segment.
"It's a perfect fit in terms of segment," he said.
The Dutch banking and insurance group also said the purchase would make a small positive contribution to its earnings per share in the first year but Polet declined to elaborate.
He said ING, which has long indicated its interest in making a U.S. life insurance acquisition, had been looking specifically at Equitable of Iowa for a couple of months.
ING is estimated to have a war chest of between eight and 10 billion guilders ($4 billion to $5 billion) for acquisitions.
